subject: CXO handshake + slot deconfliction for CloudCrest demo
messages:
From: Ari Santos <ari@cloudcrest.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marta.ruiz@cloudcrest.com, sales@cloudcrest.com
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo request — looking for VP/CIO attendance

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. CloudCrest is excited to see Redwood in action — we have a pilot window and would like an exec-level intro during the demo so our CIO (Samir Patel) and VP of Platforms (Marta Ruiz) can join for the security and routing discussion.

High-level asks:
- 45 minute demo with 15 minute exec intro + Q&A
- Can Redwood include someone senior (VP/Director level) to speak to deployment options and SLAs?
- We prefer Tue or Wed next week, morning PT.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and our internal stakeholder list. If there are any NDAs or extra steps (procurement/security), flag them and we’ll move quickly.

Best,
Ari
Ari Santos
Head of Platform Partnerships | CloudCrest
ari@cloudcrest.com

Attachments: CloudCrest_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ari Santos <ari@cloudcrest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — looking for VP/CIO attendance

Thanks Ari — great to meet you.

We can absolutely include an exec-level presence. Proposed plan:
- 45 minutes total: 15 min exec intro ( myself + Ben Carter, Director of Solutions ) / 25 min demo / 5 min next steps
- Candidate slots (PT mornings):
  • Tue 2029-08-06 09:00–09:45 PT
  • Wed 2029-08-07 10:00–10:45 PT

Ben will cover the Dedicated/Private deployment tradeoffs and I’ll handle the roadmap/rollout cadence. Priyom is looped for recording/ops notes and can confirm if we need a separate procurement thread.

Two quick items:
- We’ll send a short security brief (attaching Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf) ahead of the demo.
- If CloudCrest prefers the session not be recorded, please confirm in reply. Otherwise we’ll record for internal follow-up.

If neither slot works, let me know preferred windows and any timezone constraints for your CIO.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ari Santos <ari@cloudcrest.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 13:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — looking for VP/CIO attendance

Ari — quick note from my side:

If Samir (CIO) plans to dig into audit logging and private cloud options, I’ll prepare a short appendix covering:
- Dedicated capacity sizing and headroom for peak inference
- Audit log export and retention controls (SOC2-aligned defaults)
- Fallback routing policies for cross-region failover

Also: we often prefer an executive intro from Redwood to be a product + customer success pairing — I can do the product-side and Priyom can speak to rollout/QA expectations.

One ask: is procurement already engaged, or should we include a brief procurement sync (15 min) after the demo?

— Ben
Benjamin Carter
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Ari Santos <ari@cloudcrest.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@cloudcrest.com>, sales@cloudcrest.com
Date: Sat, 3 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — looking for VP/CIO attendance

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Wed 2029-08-07 10:00 PT works best for Samir and Marta. Please go ahead and lock that slot.

Recording: we are fine with an internal recording for Redwood’s follow-up, but CloudCrest execs prefer the recording not be shared externally.

Procurement: they’re tentatively engaged. I’ll drop a short invite for a 15-minute procurement follow-up on the same day (after demo) — cc’ing our procurement alias.

Final checklist for the demo:
- Attendees: Samir Patel (CIO), Marta Ruiz (VP Platforms), Ari Santos (Head of Partnerships)
- Redwood: Olga Petrov (Sr AE), Ben Carter (Director, Solutions), Priyom Das (CS Ops)
- Deliverables: security brief, brief on Dedicated sizing, mutual action plan next steps

Thanks — see you Wed 10:00 PT.

Best,
Ari

On attachments: confirmed they received both PDFs in the first mail.
